title: Adaptive circuit governor and soft-landing fallback runway for mixed-model dependencies
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Intermittent third-party model endpoints and internal model pool congestion cause spikes in p99 latency and error rates. Current binary 'trip' breakers are too coarse for mixed workloads (short inference vs long-context reruns) and do not offer safe partial-return behavior for high-priority tenants. We need a nuanced circuit governor that: (1) operates per dependency, per model variant, and can optionally be scoped per-tenant; (2) uses multi-signal trip logic (latency + error + capacity headroom) with hysteresis and decay; (3) provides an orchestrated "soft-landing" fallback runway that enables graceful degradation (partial responses, cached prefixes, light model fallback, or reduced tokens) rather than abrupt failures; (4) integrates with multi-region failover and preserves SLOs where possible.
acceptance_criteria: New circuit governor can be configured at dependency, model, and tenant scope via runtime config and Console UI

Trip decision uses combined signals: rolling 3m error-rate, p99 latency percentile, and active-kv-cache utilization; experiments show >10% reduction in full-client-side failures during simulated dependency degradations

Soft-landing runway supports 3 fallback modes: prefix-cache-return, distilled-model-fallback (smaller quantized variant), and truncated-response-with-metadata; fallbacks are selectable by policy and prefer non-breaking outputs
Governor exposes metrics: trip_score (0..1), trip_state (closed/soft-open/open), last_trip_reason, decay_time_remaining, and fallback_mode_active; dashboards and alerting are added to Console
Rollback and manual-override exist (API + Console button) and are tested in staged rollout with canary tenants
End-to-end e2e tests simulate region failover + dependency outage; SLOs for critical tenants degrade no more than 5% relative to baseline when soft-landing is available
tasks: Draft design RFC and fallback matrix (link in attachments)
Prototype trip_score computation in sandbox (rolling-window moving-average + exponential decay)
Implement governor control plane hooks and per-entity config schema
Integrate fallback executors: prefix-cache, distilled-model routing, truncated-response pipeline
Add Circuit Governor metrics and Console panels; instrument runbook links in alerts
Run chaos experiments (region-local and multi-region) and collect telemetry
Iterate thresholds based on A/B with 5 canary tenants
Create rollback/playbook and schedule ops runbook walkthrough
